verdict.rationale: Babylon.js clearly ships real profiling tools — the Inspector/Scene Inspector for runtime debugging and scene analysis, plus community confirmation of the Spector.js WebGL debugger — but there is no documented ECS, job/worker system, or GPU instancing API in the evidence pack for scaling heavy scenes. Community notes even flag historical GC/allocation pressure concerns around performance-sensitive code.  missing for 10: explicit ECS architecture, job/worker-based parallelism, and documented instancing API/guidance for scaling heavy scenes.
